extension.summary: Shows the Red Light Autoplay Next Episode popup with dummy details.
extension.description: Opens the Autoplay Next Episode popup with dummy show and episode details, so its style can be checked without playing an episode. The buttons only close the popup, and Back or Escape also closes it. Does not need Red Light.
extension.news: 1.0.2: The add-on icon has a new file name, so Kodi shows the Autoplay icon on every device. No other changes. 1.0.1: Opens over a demo background image. The popup has the new layout, 20 px corners, a 1.5 px outline and a drop shadow. The icon is an Autoplay button. 1.0.0: First release. Shows Red Light's Autoplay Next Episode popup with dummy details.
